justification: libs.js is a pre-built bundle with jQuery 2.1.0 compiled in alongside Terrific 1.1.1 and Foundation 5.5.0, so the jQuery inside it cannot be upgraded independently. The blocker is Foundation, not Terrific: Foundation 5.5.0 calls the .load() and .error() event shorthands that jQuery 3.0 removed, in three places. Every page loads this file, but the known issues (CVE-2015-9251, CVE-2019-11358, CVE-2020-11022, CVE-2020-11023) all require attacker-controlled input reaching jQuery's DOM manipulation or AJAX methods, which this static site does not do. Ignored so the scan still fails on any newly added vulnerable library. See FRONTEND-DEPS.md for the two routes to removing this entry.
